title: Data Lake, Lakehouse & BigLake — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Dataplex Data Quality & Quarantine Pipeline: automated data profiling catches 15% missing null values and diverts dirty data into quarantine bucket.
routing_rationale: Dataplex automated data quality tasks inspect analytical datasets before downstream consumption, quarantining bad data to prevent corrupting executive dashboards.

nodes.label: Corrupted Vendor CSV Upload
nodes.detail: Third-party vendor uploaded daily sales batch missing primary key values.

nodes.label: Dataplex Auto Data Profiling
nodes.detail: Profiles batch; detects 15% null values violating quality rule DQ_089.

nodes.label: Quarantine Bucket (GCS)
nodes.detail: Isolates rejected records and alerts vendor data engineering team in Slack.

nodes.label: Clean Production Lakehouse
nodes.detail: Downstream executive dashboards only ingest 100% verified clean data.

steps.title: Automated Quality Profiling
steps.action: Dataplex inspects rows against declarative rules and catches 15% null violations.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents dirty data from contaminating downstream analytics.

steps.title: Quarantine & Clean Ingestion
steps.action: Diverts corrupt rows to quarantine while allowing valid records to proceed to BigQuery.
steps.why_traversal: Maintains pipeline flow without halting entire enterprise data ingestion.

scenarios.label: Dirty Data Corrupts Executive Revenue Dashboard
scenarios.root_cause: Quality check was configured in 'alert only' mode without active quarantine routing.
scenarios.diverted_path: Corrupt null records loaded into production; revenue reports showed 15% false dip.
scenarios.blast_radius: C-suite alarmed by false financial drop.
scenarios.recovery: Enable automated quarantine routing in Dataplex quality task definitions.
